archetype: Archetype 5 (Luxury) - Modified with user-requested grays, blacks, whites, and deep purples.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Asymmetric Tetris Grid (Mode A) for the photography gallery. Wide gaps (gap-8), varying col-spans and row-spans to create an editorial, museum-like layout.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border (border-white/5), no heavy shadows. Strict and clean.
surfaces_and_borders.glassmorphism: Only for sticky header or floating chatbot window. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0C0A0D]/70 border-b border-white/10.
surfaces_and_borders.radius: rounded-none or minimal rounded-sm (2px) for sharp, premium feel.

components.buttons: Solid primary color for main CTA, or ghost with 1px border. Sharp corners. Explicit hover text color.
components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphic header, visible on desktop with logo, links, and cart icon.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components. Override default radius to rounded-none. Input fields with bg-surface, border-border, focus:border-accent.

media_and_images.rules: Never use placeholder text or dummy images. Always use provided URLs. Maintain high contrast for text over images using gradient overlays.

hero_background.description: Cinematic Semana Santa procession for the main hero section.

about_photographers.description: Portrait of Gonzalo Lara and Manuel Gonzalez for the About Us section.

gallery_paso.description: Fine art photo of Virgin Mary paso, use in gallery.

gallery_nazareno.description: Black and white portrait of a nazareno, use in gallery.

gallery_incense.description: Incense smoke photo for atmospheric shots in gallery or about section.

key_functionalities: Hero section: Use 'hero_background' with a max overlay opacity of bg-black/40. No heavier. Use gradient overlay if needed.
Gallery: Must be filterable (Hermandades, Eventos, Pueblos). Use an asymmetric grid layout. Each image should be purchasable (digital or physical).
E-commerce: Shopping cart system with a checkout flow. Payment options MUST be manual: 'Pago con Bizum' and 'Efectivo'.
About Us: 2 photographers (Gonzalo Lara & Manuel González). Use 'about_photographers' image.
Instagram Feed: Static gallery layout linking directly to @gonzalo_0702 and @manugfotos.
Chatbot: AI Chatbot floating UI for FAQs (sizes, contracts).
Admin Panel: Build a basic layout for uploading photos.
MUST use data-testid for all interactive and key elements.
design_rules: No generic tech gradients. Use solid colors and high-end photographic textures.
Do not center everything. Use optical alignment and asymmetric layouts.
Do not use Inter for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond.
Dark theme only. Colors must exactly match the provided hex codes in this JSON.
